title: SlashGoodnight
description: A lightweight vote-based plugin that lets players skip the night using /gn, /goodnight, or /skipnight.
body:
# **🌙 SlashGoodnight ☀️**

SlashGoodnight is a lightweight quality-of-life plugin that allows players to vote to skip the night without sleeping.
When 50% of online players vote using simple commands, the night is skipped naturally while preserving the world day counter.

Perfect for survival and SMP servers.

![SkipTheNight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b82b0c893fc5b85f92fce82eee4430bd19b2108b.jpeg)

## ✨ Features

• Vote-based night skipping
• Works only during night time
• Natural time progression (/time add, not /time set)
• Keeps day counter 100% accurate
• No dependencies
• Lightweight & lag-free

## 📜 Commands
Command	Description
/gn
/goodnight
/skipnight

## ⚙ Compatibility

Platforms: Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur
Minecraft versions: 1.20+

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin

2. Place the .jar in your /plugins folder

3. Restart the server
